summary: The diff demonstrates comprehensive implementation of all three requirements. The backend adds a serialNumber field to the Staff type with auto-increment logic (nextSerialNumber starting at 1), includes migration code for canister upgrades, and automatically assigns serial numbers during staff creation. The frontend displays the serial number column in the staff table (sorted in ascending order) and does not include a serial number input field in the add/edit forms. All acceptance criteria appear to be satisfied.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) for handling canister upgrades and migrating existing staff data to include serial numbers
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention creating a migration system or handling existing staff data. While REQ-2 requires serial numbers to persist across canister upgrades, it does not explicitly request a migration module for retroactive assignment of serial numbers to existing staff.
